style: Use the attached cheetah ONLY as the STYLE REFERENCE for a cohesive Animal Racing League collection. Create ONE INDIVIDUAL illustration of the species described below, NOT a cheetah or a group. Match premium cute-but-not-childish expressive 3D character design, softly rounded sculpted forms, warm natural colors, soft upper-left lighting, clean shading and lively eye treatment. Keep fur detail subdued and forms readable as a 32px icon. Full body facing RIGHT, slight three-quarter side view, anatomically recognizable adult animal in a compact poised running or walking stance. Correct limb count, separated readable limbs. IMPORTANT: do NOT copy the reference's tight framing. Zoom OUT: the COMPLETE animal must fit WITHIN the central 80% of the square canvas. Leave a completely TRANSPARENT BORDER of at least 10% on EVERY side, including between the canvas edge and the fur, tail, antlers, feet and face. No body part can touch any canvas edge. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, isolated character only, no floor, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no border, no accessories unless specified. Preserve distinct species anatomy.

species.cheetah: Cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus): golden slender feline with SOLID black spots, black facial tear lines, rounded ears, long banded tail, four long legs, full-body running right.
species.horse: CHESTNUT HORSE. Athletic adult chestnut horse, long equine muzzle, black mane and flowing black tail, four slender legs with four hooves. No saddle, bridle, rider or clothing.
species.greyhound: GREYHOUND DOG. Sleek blue-grey short coat, white chest patch, exceptionally deep narrow chest and tucked-up abdomen, long slender legs, long fine muzzle, rose-fold ears, thin curved tail. Not a generic dog or wolf. Four legs.
species.wolf: GREY WOLF. Silver-grey coat, darker saddle, cream cheeks and underside, long muzzle, erect triangular ears, bushy low tail, four athletic legs. Not a husky with curled tail.
species.hippo: HIPPOPOTAMUS. Muted plum-grey smooth skin, huge barrel body, broad squared muzzle with nostrils above, tiny round high-set ears, four short chunky legs, tiny tail. Charming confident expression, mostly closed mouth.
species.squirrel: EASTERN GREY SQUIRREL. Silver-grey squirrel with cream belly and soft russet accents, small round ears without long tufts, enormous fluffy plume tail curling up behind LEFT, small dexterous forepaws, large hind feet. Four limbs, poised to bound right. Not a chipmunk, no back stripes. Leave extra space around the entire tail.
species.elephant: AFRICAN SAVANNA ELEPHANT. Slate-grey body, very large fan-shaped African ears, two ivory tusks, one long trunk curving forward/down toward RIGHT, four thick legs and rounded toenails, small tail. Entire trunk in frame.
species.rhino: WHITE RHINOCEROS (Ceratotherium simum). Stout grey African rhinoceros with a broad SQUARE upper lip, TWO horns on nose (front longer, rear shorter), small rounded ears, muscular heavy body and four short thick legs with three-toed feet. Subtle skin folds, not plate armor of an Indian rhino. Right-facing and fully framed.
species.ostrich: OSTRICH. Flightless adult male ostrich with rounded black feathered body, white wing and tail feathers, long slender pale pink-grey neck, small head with tan beak facing RIGHT, large bright eyes and TWO long strong pink-grey legs with two-toed feet. Folded wings on body. Compact running stride, anatomically bird-like, not a duck or flamingo.
species.kangaroo: RED KANGAROO. Warm reddish-tan fur, creamy belly, long upright ears, small pointed face, TWO short forearms, TWO large powerful elongated hind legs and long heavy balancing tail extending behind LEFT. Compact hopping-ready stance facing RIGHT, all limbs and full tail visible. No joey or accessories.
species.lion: ADULT MALE LION. Tawny golden muscular feline with a rich caramel-brown full mane framing a recognizable lion face, cream muzzle, small rounded ears, long tail with dark tuft, FOUR legs. Friendly determined mature expression. Walking/running RIGHT. Not a cheetah; no spots.
species.tiger: BENGAL TIGER. Orange coat with distinct BLACK STRIPES, white cheeks, muzzle, underside, small round ears, large feline paws on FOUR legs and a long striped tail curved behind LEFT. Muscular and expressive; not a leopard or cheetah. Facing RIGHT.
species.bear: BROWN BEAR (Ursus arctos). Rich brown bear with heavy muscular shoulders and a recognizable shoulder hump, small round ears, short broad muzzle, cream-brown muzzle, tiny tail and FOUR sturdy legs with broad paws. Compact right-facing walking/running posture, not standing like a person.
species.human: HUMAN RUNNER. One athletic adult woman with warm medium-brown skin, expressive friendly face, dark hair in a compact ponytail, teal sleeveless running top, warm terracotta shorts and neutral cream running shoes. TWO arms and TWO legs in natural right-facing jogging stride, hands with normal anatomy, full head and both shoes in frame. Same premium softly shaded 3D character style, grown-up proportions, no text, jewelry or equipment.
species.rabbit: EUROPEAN RABBIT. Soft natural grey-brown fur, cream belly, two LONG upright rabbit ears, small dark-tipped nose, short fluffy white tail, TWO small forelegs and TWO powerful larger hind legs. Compact poised bounding stride toward RIGHT. Four feet discernible; not a hare with huge thin body.
species.tortoise: HERMANN'S TORTOISE (Testudo hermanni). Small terrestrial tortoise with a high domed yellow-ochre and dark-brown patterned scute shell, olive-tan wrinkled head, short beak-like muzzle, FOUR short sturdy clawed legs and a small pointed tail. Walking RIGHT on feet, no aquatic flippers, not a sea turtle. Expressive but anatomically tortoise face.
species.sloth: BROWN-THROATED THREE-TOED SLOTH. Shaggy warm grey-brown fur, round pale face with dark eye mask patches, tiny ears, small dark nose and gentle smile, TWO very long forearms with THREE curved claws per forepaw and TWO shorter hind legs. Awkward low terrestrial crawl to RIGHT, belly above ground; no branch or tree. Fully visible four limbs, no extra arms.
species.platypus: PLATYPUS (Ornithorhynchus anatinus). A real recognizable platypus, not a beaver: low streamlined dark chocolate-brown fur body, broad FLAT slate-grey DUCK BILL facing RIGHT, small dark eyes above bill, FOUR short splayed legs with webbed feet, long broad flat paddle-shaped brown tail extending behind LEFT. No buck teeth, no ears sticking up. Compact land waddle stance.
species.seal: ADULT MALE SOUTHERN ELEPHANT SEAL. Large smooth charcoal-grey elongated rounded blubbery body, heavy chest, TWO short foreflippers supporting front, TWO rear flippers together at tail end to LEFT. Broad rounded face facing RIGHT with a distinctive SHORT INFLATABLE ELEPHANT-SEAL NOSE above the mouth, small bright eyes, whiskers and no external ears. Body hauled low on land, NOT an elephant trunk, NOT a walrus, no tusks, no legs or paws.
species.penguin: EMPEROR PENGUIN. Recognizable adult emperor penguin with black back and head, creamy white belly, golden-yellow neck/ear patches, long dark beak pointing RIGHT, TWO short black flipper wings and TWO orange-grey webbed feet. Upright gently leaning forward in a compact rightward waddle, not a generic baby penguin.
species.crocodile: NILE CROCODILE. Olive green-grey crocodile with long tapered armored body, TWO eyes high on head, broad but elongated tapered toothed muzzle facing RIGHT, cream underside, dorsal scutes, FOUR short splayed legs with clawed toes, ONE long tapering tail curving behind to LEFT. Compact bent-tail composition with complete tail visible. No extra legs, no mammal ears or horn.
species.gorilla: WESTERN LOWLAND SILVERBACK GORILLA. Dark charcoal fur, silver-grey back, very broad muscular chest, dark bare flat gorilla face with prominent brow and wide nostrils, TWO long muscular forearms ending in knuckles and TWO shorter hind legs. Right-facing terrestrial knuckle-walking posture. Four limbs only, NO TAIL. Recognizable gorilla rather than chimpanzee or monkey.
species.pronghorn: PRONGHORN (Antilocapra americana), not a generic deer. Slender sandy-tan ungulate, white belly and rump, two white throat stripes, dark cheek patch, TWO BLACK backward-curving horns each with a short forward prong, pointed ears, short tail and FOUR slim hoofed legs. Entire horns and hooves visible; no branched deer antlers. Running RIGHT.
species.zebra: PLAINS ZEBRA. Stocky equine body with crisp BLACK AND WHITE STRIPES, short upright striped mane, large rounded ears, striped face pointing RIGHT, black muzzle, long tail with dark tuft, FOUR slender striped legs with dark hooves. No saddle. Not a horse with random patches.
species.giraffe: GIRAFFE. Very long elegant upright neck and FOUR long slender legs, warm ochre coat with large irregular brown PATCHES and cream separators, two small fur-covered ossicones, large ears, short dark mane, small tail with dark tuft, right-facing long muzzle. Whole head, ossicones, hooves and tail inside frame; use a smaller full-body composition to leave generous clear margins. No tiny baby proportions.
species.fox: RED FOX. Russet-orange coat, cream-white cheeks chest and belly, dark lower legs, narrow pointed black nose, tall triangular ears and a very bushy orange tail with a WHITE TIP extending behind LEFT. FOUR agile legs. Clever adult expression, full body running RIGHT. Not a wolf or generic orange dog.
species.hyena: SPOTTED HYENA (Crocuta crocuta). Sandy beige-grey fur with dark SPOTS, large rounded ears, dark blunt muzzle, strong neck and chest, higher forequarters and visibly sloping back, short dark mane and dark bushy short tail. FOUR paws, long forelegs and shorter hindquarters. Running RIGHT; not a striped hyena or spotted dog.
species.warthog: COMMON WARTHOG. Grey-brown coarse-haired pig with large elongated head, broad flattened snout facing RIGHT, TWO curved ivory tusks turning upward, small facial warts, sparse long mane, thin tail held upright behind with dark tuft, FOUR short legs with cloven hooves. Full tusks and tail inside frame, not a domestic pig.
species.moose: ADULT MALE MOOSE. Dark warm brown coat, massive long muzzle facing RIGHT, a small throat bell, tall legs, humped shoulders, TWO broad flat PALMATE antlers with several edge tines, FOUR long legs with cloven hooves, small tail. Both full antlers inside frame, extra space above and to right. Not a red deer with thin branching antlers.
species.goat: DOMESTIC GOAT. Cream-white short fur, angular face facing RIGHT, rectangular dark pupils, two modest backward-curving horns, small pointed beard, upright short tail and FOUR nimble legs with cloven hooves. Compact bounding-ready stance, adult proportions, not a sheep with wool.
species.capybara: CAPYBARA. Large rounded brown rodent with coarse warm brown fur, characteristic broad BLUNT RECTANGULAR muzzle facing RIGHT, high-set small round ears, dark eyes, FOUR short sturdy legs with small partly webbed toes. No visible tail, no rabbit ears, no guinea-pig baby proportions. Calm dignified expression, rightward land trot.
species.duck: MALE MALLARD DUCK. Shiny emerald-green head, yellow broad duck bill pointing RIGHT, thin white neck ring, rich chestnut chest, pale grey body, dark tail and a small cobalt blue speculum patch on the folded wing, TWO orange webbed feet. TWO folded wings, no flight. Entire body right-facing in waddling pose, not a generic yellow duckling.
species.chicken: DOMESTIC CHICKEN HEN. Warm golden-brown and russet feathers, small red comb and red wattles, short pale yellow beak pointing RIGHT, TWO folded feathered wings, short upturned tail feathers, TWO strong yellow scaly legs with normal chicken toes. Full-body compact running stance, grown hen, not a rooster with enormous tail or a chick.
species.snail: GARDEN SNAIL (Cornu aspersum). One warm brown snail with a round SPIRAL-SHELLED house in tan and dark chocolate bands, soft muted grey-brown elongated muscular FOOT/body facing RIGHT, TWO long upper eyestalks ending in tiny expressive eyes and TWO much shorter lower feelers by the mouth. NO LEGS, NO ARMS. Entire shell, tail and eyestalks inside frame. Charming mature 3D design, no slime trail or ground shadow.
species.bison: AMERICAN BISON. Massive shaggy dark brown FOREQUARTERS with a pronounced high SHOULDER HUMP, huge bearded head facing RIGHT, two small pale upcurving horns, smaller smoother tan-brown hindquarters, short tail with dark tuft and FOUR sturdy legs with black hooves. Characteristic heavy front silhouette, not a cow or water buffalo.
species.camel: DROMEDARY CAMEL. Warm sandy beige fur, ONE SINGLE HUMP on the back, long curved neck with friendly mature face looking RIGHT, small rounded ears, split upper lip, FOUR long slender legs ending in broad two-toed padded feet and thin tufted tail. Full hump and all four feet visible. Not a two-humped Bactrian camel.
species.quokka: Brown wallaby with round ears, short broad muzzle, black nose, hunched back, cream belly, two small forearms, two strong hind legs, relatively short slender bare tail; not a squirrel tail.
species.wombat: Stocky grey-brown burrowing marsupial, broad blunt bare nose, small round ears, four short strong clawed legs, almost invisible tail; adult barrel body.
species.pangolin: Overlapping ochre-brown keratin scales, long thick tapering scaled tail, small tapered head, no teeth visible, four limbs with large curved foreclaws, walking low; no armadillo armor bands.
species.aardvark: Pink-grey sparse-haired body, very long rabbit-like ears, elongated pig-like snout, arched back, four digging legs, thick tapering tail; no tusks.
species.echidna: Low dark brown body covered in cream-tipped spines, long narrow tubular beak, no external ear pinnae, four short sprawling digging limbs; no porcupine tail.
species.armadillo: Grey bony armor with flexible transverse midbody bands, pointed snout, large upright ears, long ring-armored tail, four short clawed legs.
species.giant-anteater: Long narrow tubular muzzle, small ears, grey-brown body with bold diagonal black and white shoulder stripe, huge shaggy tail, four legs; forefeet folded onto knuckles around long claws.
species.meerkat: Slender sandy mongoose with dark eye patches, tiny round ears, pointed nose, faint dark back bands, thin black-tipped tail, four legs in walking stance; not upright human posture.
species.badger: Low broad grey body, white head with two bold black eye-to-ear stripes, small ears, black legs, four digging paws, short tail.
species.wolverine: Stocky dark brown mustelid, broad head, small rounded ears, pale tan lateral flank bands, bushy short tail and four powerful plantigrade paws; no bear hump.
species.raccoon: Grey coat, black eye mask, white brows and muzzle, bushy tail with distinct dark rings, four legs with dexterous five-toed forepaws.
species.red-panda: Russet fluffy coat, white ear rims and cheeks, dark tear marks, black belly and legs, long alternating russet-ringed bushy tail, four paws; not a giant panda.
species.fossa: Long sleek tawny-brown Malagasy carnivoran, small rounded ears, catlike short muzzle, four muscular legs, very long smooth cylindrical tail; no spots.
species.ring-tailed-lemur: Grey lemur with white face, black eye patches and muzzle, orange eyes, very long black-and-white ringed tail arcing behind, four limbs in terrestrial walk; no extra tail.
species.olive-baboon: Adult olive-brown baboon with long dark dog-like muzzle, small rounded ears, four strong limbs in quadrupedal walk, single arched tail with downturned end; not a tailless ape.
species.crested-porcupine: Large dark rodent, long black-and-white banded quills fanning backwards and tall head crest, small rounded ears, blunt muzzle, four short clawed legs, short quilled tail.
species.hedgehog: Small domed brown spine-covered body, pale furry pointed face, tiny round ears, black nose, four short feet; not porcupine-long quills.
species.tenrec: Coarse brown bristly body with sparse short spines, long pointed pale muzzle, prominent whiskers, small ears, four short legs, no conspicuous tail; not a hedgehog ball.
species.shrew: Tiny dark brown velvety mammal, elongated flexible pointed snout, tiny eyes and ears, pale belly, four small feet, slender medium-length tail; not a mouse with round ears.
species.elephant-shrew: Rufous forebody and black hindquarters, long flexible downward-pointed trunk-like snout, large ears, slender long legs, narrow bare tail; not a miniature elephant.
species.springhare: Sandy large jumping rodent, long ears, large dark eyes, two short forelimbs and two extremely long hind feet, long furry black-tipped tail, cream belly; not a kangaroo pouch.
species.okapi: Dark chocolate adult forest giraffid, short neck, large rounded ears, white lower face, white zebra-like stripes only on rump and upper legs, four long cloven-hoofed legs, small ossicones; not a full striped zebra.
species.cassowary: Adult black shaggy flightless bird, bare cobalt-blue neck, two red wattles, tall brown casque on head, two powerful grey three-toed legs with long inner claws, tiny folded wings.
species.emu: Tall flightless bird with shaggy brown drooping double feathers, dark head and blue-grey upper neck, short broad beak, two long strong grey three-toed legs, tiny near-invisible wings; no casque.
species.secretary-bird: Tall grey terrestrial raptor, long black-feathered thighs and long bare lower legs, black quill crest behind head, orange-red bare eye patch, hooked beak, long central tail feathers and two folded wings.
species.roadrunner: Slender streaked brown ground cuckoo, erect ragged crest, long straight tail, pointed grey beak, pale belly, two long running legs with two toes forward and two back; no cartoon purple plumage.
species.kiwi: Round brown shaggy flightless bird, very long slender ivory bill with nostrils at tip, tiny eyes, no visible tail, wings hidden in plumage, two sturdy three-toed legs.
species.wild-turkey: Adult male dark bronze wild turkey, bare blue-red head and red wattle, modest snood, folded wings, closed broad brown barred tail rather than display fan, two sturdy scaly legs.
species.guineafowl: Round charcoal body densely patterned with small white spots, tiny blue bare head with brown helmet and red wattles, short tail, folded wings, two dark running legs.
species.peafowl: Adult male with blue neck and head, small upright fan crest, green scaled upper back, long folded green eye-spotted train trailing compactly behind, two legs and folded wings; full train in frame, no display fan.
species.seriema: Long-legged buff-grey ground bird, red bill and legs, upright wispy forehead crest, long neck, dark barred tail, folded wings; two three-forward-toed feet, not a secretary bird.
species.kori-bustard: Large heavy brown mottled ground bird, thick grey barred neck, black swept-back crown tuft, white belly, long pale legs, folded wings and short tail; two three-toed feet.
species.tinamou: Plump olive-brown subtly barred forest bird, small grey head and slender neck, short slightly curved bill, very short tail, tucked wings, two stout grey legs; not a kiwi beak.
species.lyrebird: Brown adult male ground bird, long delicate tail with two outer lyre-shaped feathers and fine central filaments, slim dark beak, strong scratching feet, two folded wings; tail arched compactly fully in frame.
species.komodo-dragon: Heavy grey-brown monitor lizard with granular scales, long low head, four powerful splayed clawed limbs, very long muscular tapering tail, forked tongue; no spikes, frill or wings.
species.gila-monster: Stocky orange-pink and black bead-scaled lizard, broad head, thick short banded tail, four short splayed clawed limbs; no dorsal spines.
species.bearded-dragon: Sandy tan lizard with broad triangular head, spiny beard under jaw, flattened oval body, small lateral spines, four splayed clawed legs, long tapering tail; no neck frill.
species.frilled-lizard: Brown slender lizard with large circular pleated orange-edged neck frill partly expanded, two long hind legs in bipedal run and two small raised forelegs, very long thin tail; no extra legs.
species.horned-lizard: Broad flattened sand-coloured body, crown of pointed head horns, two long rear head horns, rough spiny back and side fringes, four short splayed legs, short pointed tail; not thorny devil.
species.thorny-devil: Ochre and brown desert lizard densely covered in large conical spines, hornlike head spikes, false-head hump behind neck, four short splayed limbs, stiff short spiny tail.
species.blue-tongued-skink: Smooth shiny broad brown-banded skink, large triangular head, briefly visible broad blue tongue, cylindrical body, four very small five-toed legs, thick tapering tail.
species.leopard-gecko: Yellow and pale cream gecko with black spots, moveable eyelids, thick segmented fat tail, four small legs with clawed slender toes WITHOUT adhesive toe pads.
species.tuatara: Stout olive-grey reptile, triangular head, small white dorsal crest from head along back, four sprawling clawed limbs, long thick tapering tail; modest crest, no iguana dewlap.
species.rosy-boa: Small thick-bodied smooth-scaled boa, three reddish-brown LONGITUDINAL stripes on pale cream-grey body, blunt small head, compact flowing S-shaped slither right; absolutely no limbs, no hood.
species.common-toad: Warty brown adult toad, squat body, copper eyes with horizontal pupils, large oval parotoid glands behind eyes, two short forelegs and two bent hind legs, no tail.
species.fire-salamander: Shiny black terrestrial salamander with irregular bold yellow patches, broad head, four short limbs, four front toes and five rear toes, round-section tapering tail; no gills or fins.
species.tiger-salamander: Stout terrestrial adult salamander, dark brown body with irregular yellow-olive blotches, broad round head, four short limbs, long thick tapering tail; no external larval gills.
species.tomato-frog: Round plump red-orange adult female terrestrial frog, orange eyes, pale belly, two small forelegs and two short folded hind legs, no horns, no tail.
species.ornate-horned-frog: Broad round green and brown patterned terrestrial frog, enormous wide mouth, small pointed raised eyelid horns, pale underside, two small forelegs and two folded powerful hind legs; not bull horns.
species.golden-mantella: Tiny uniformly bright golden-orange terrestrial frog, without dark dorsal spots, black round eyes, smooth skin, two small forelegs and two folded long hind legs, slender toes, no tail; no oversized treefrog toe discs.
species.tarantula: Hairy brown tarantula with pinkish copper carapace, TWO body sections, EIGHT jointed walking legs, two short pedipalps beside downward fangs, tiny clustered real spider eyes; no antennae, no cartoon eyeball stalks.
species.scorpion: Glossy black scorpion, EIGHT walking legs plus TWO large grasping pedipalp pincers, segmented narrow tail curving above back ending in reddish stinger, small eyes; no antennae.
species.coconut-crab: Adult terrestrial coconut crab, blue-purple and rust armored broad body, two massive front claws with left larger, three pairs of obvious walking legs, reduced rear fifth pair tucked under body, long antennae, short abdomen curled under, no external shell.
species.tiger-beetle: Metallic emerald green beetle, six small cream elytral spots, large eyes and curved jaws, SIX long jointed running legs, two antennae, closed wing cases; never eight legs.
species.silver-ant: Silvery-haired desert worker ant, three clear body regions, narrow waist, SIX long thin jointed legs, two elbowed antennae, large dark eyes, no wings.
species.cockroach: Large wingless mahogany and black oval cockroach, segmented abdomen, broad dark shield behind small head, two long antennae, SIX spiny running legs, no wings.
species.mantis: Adult green praying mantis, triangular mobile head, two compound eyes, two fine antennae, long prothorax, SIX legs total: two folded spined raptorial forelegs and four walking legs, folded wings.
species.stick-insect: Wingless brown-green stick insect, extremely elongated twiglike body, SIX very long slender jointed legs, two fine antennae, tiny head, no leaf wings.
species.giant-millipede: Glossy dark chocolate cylindrical millipede with many ring segments, TWO PAIRS of short reddish legs per midbody segment, two short antennae, compact shallow C-shaped right-facing walking form; no pincers.
species.centipede: Flattened reddish-brown centipede with dark head, 21 pairs of yellow legs, ONE leg pair per trunk segment, long antennae, elongated rear leg pair; no millipede cylinder, no scorpion tail.
species.earthworm: Pink-brown segmented adult earthworm with swollen pale clitellum nearer front, tapering ends, compact natural curve facing right, NO eyes, NO limbs, NO antennae; subtle moist shading without slime trail.
species.slug: Black terrestrial slug, rounded mantle on front back, elongated muscular foot, TWO upper eye-bearing tentacles and TWO short lower sensory tentacles, no shell, no limbs, no trail.
species.velvet-worm: Brown velvety soft wormlike body, 34 pairs of short closely spaced unjointed stubby lobopod legs in an adult male, two curved antennae, tiny dark eyes and two small oral papillae; no insect armor or centipede joints.
species.woodlouse: Small grey flattened oval terrestrial isopod, rough overlapping dorsal plates, SEVEN pairs of walking legs, two main antennae, short rear uropods, no snail shell, walking rather than rolled up.
